data.one_liner: Flutter RTMP live stream client to broadcast video and audio from smartphone camera.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to stream video and audio via RTMP directly from a smartphone camera in your Flutter application. It provides controllers, a camera preview widget, and handles video/audio configurations for live broadcasting.
use_when: You need to stream live video and audio via RTMP from a mobile device.
You are integrating api.video live streaming features into your Flutter application.
avoid_when: You only need standard video playback rather than broadcasting.
You need complex local video recording without RTMP streaming.
strengths: Official RTMP live stream client for api.video.
Provides a simple ApiVideoCameraPreview widget and controller setup.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and permission handling for Android and iOS.
Limited to Android and iOS platforms as a plugin.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding internet, camera, and microphone permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and usage descriptions in iOS Info.plist.
